comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: PinPlugin state is WeakMap keyed by EditorView — second view starts empty and the first view decorations are destroyed on parent re-render.

content.text: PinPlugin state is WeakMap keyed by EditorView — second view starts empty and the first view decorations are destroyed on parent re-render.

Pinned comment markers (gutter icons that jump to a pinned thread) show correctly in single-pane editor. Opening the same document in split view (two panes, same doc id) causes all pinned markers to disappear in both panes until the document is closed and opened again in single view.

Markers should remain bound to document positions independent of pane count. Split view mounts a second EditorView that re-inits plugin state from an empty pin list because the pin plugin keys state by view instance rather than document id.
Reviewers who use split to compare sections lose pin navigation. Sharing pin plugin state across views for the same doc id should keep markers visible.
